content.comment_body: Hello all, I created a graphical visualization in [product_name] to display the statuses of the [product_name] controller. You can view both binary and analog statuses, as well as values for analog inputs and outputs. Due to the size of the [product_name] files, I am sharing a [url] containing a zip archive with the files.
I've uploaded a set of 50x50 px indicator graphics (in Indicators.zip) that you are free to use.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are responding positively to the visualization created in [product_name] for monitoring [product_name] controller statuses. Shared resources like project files and custom indicator graphics are valued and enhance user satisfaction, highlighting the customization and extendibility of the visualization. There are no reports of issues; the feedback is supportive and enhancement-focused.
